_about: Fixed vocabulary for derived fields (Agent 1 v4 stage E). Agent 1 may ONLY use these values; code rejects anything else. Agreed interface with the teammate (option A, 24 Oct). Source: values used in the teammate's v3 parsing reference, adopted as the contract; report this when scoring against that reference. Outcomes are fixed per action (the firewall verdict lives in event.action, not event.outcome - see teammate schema.json 'firewall_outcome'; a log line that only records an event has outcome unknown).

ssh_authentication.description: sshd password/publickey result line (Accepted ... / Failed password ..., including 'Failed password for invalid user ...')

ssh_invalid_user.description: sshd line that STARTS with 'Invalid user X from IP'. NOT the 'Failed password for invalid user ...' line (that one is ssh_authentication)

ssh_connection_closed.description: sshd connection ended: 'Connection closed by ...', 'Disconnected from ...', 'Received disconnect from ...' (even if it mentions an invalid user)

http_request.description: web server access log request line
